signs.dE_PT: E(ion pair) - E(neutral pair), kJ/mol per transferring pair (summary.json crystals[].fixed_ion_minus_neutral)
signs.margin: other state minus observed state (> 0: observed state lower); classification margins and their checks only
signs.toward_observed: other state minus observed state for a non-margin quantity (> 0: favours the observed state)
signs.profile: E(point) - E(P0) along the periodic path, P0 = observed-state end (not a dE_PT)
signs.lowering: -dE_PT term: by how much the environment lowers the ion pair relative to the neutral pair (> 0)
signs.unsigned: magnitude or a quantity without orientation
signs.as_stored: as stored in summary.json, orientation given in meaning

_meta.rounding: text = value rounded half to even at precision (shortest repr), true minus; + on signed energies
_meta.budget_label: estimate: shifts computed at different settings, combined additively (crystals[].budget, crystals[].resolution; gap map B4, B5)
_meta.counts_note: R5 in counts is the class of the full profile (P4r and the extra points included); the molecular rungs are scored by their two-configuration sign by design; the 95 % intervals are descriptive only (the crystals are not a random sample)

plan_check.plan: lowers the ion pair by 116-163 in the salts
cluster exceeds the periodic single site by 7-102
12/13 with wB97X on the extended profile
